verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships a dedicated durable-execution capability explicitly designed to preserve agent progress across transient API failures, application errors, or restarts, and to support long-running, asynchronous, human-in-the-loop workflows with 'production-grade reliability' — directly matching the engineering-lead's durability requirement. missing for 10: no evidence pack detail on specific named durable-execution backends/integrations (e.g., Temporal, DBOS) beyond the overview page, and no independent/hands-on corroboration that restarts actually resume correctly in production.
